_comment: Ceilings and baseline consumed by verify-deploy.sh Gate 20 (orchestrator context budget lock). Two per-file ceilings are fixed/reviewed ROADMAP.md-derived targets (not headroom-derived from measured_bytes, unlike claudemd-size-budget.json's formula). As of 2026-09-18 both tracked files are under their ceiling (see each file's own derivation for history); ORCHESTRATOR_BUDGET_GATE_MODE remains warn-tier as a recorded follow-up -- promoting it to hard is deferred until commands/orchestrate.md settles past the concurrent sibling task editing it this cycle, since any of that sibling's growth would otherwise become a hard deploy failure. eager_load.baseline_bytes is a fixed historical record (2026-09-02) copied verbatim from the task description that introduced this gate -- re-measure with 'REPO_ROOT=$(pwd) bash scripts/measure-eager-context.sh --check' and re-derive only baseline_bytes deliberately (it is the regression ceiling, not a rolling target); measured_bytes/measured_at fields are informational snapshots and may be refreshed freely.

skills/skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md.derivation: ROADMAP.md 'Budgets' target ceiling. Pre-removal measurement (this task's own baseline) was 21,317 B, 1,317 B over ceiling. The per-dispatch worktree-isolation removal task's Move 2 MUST NOT trim (dropping the isolation/worktree_path forwarding-prohibition paragraph, now moot since no dispatch row carries those fields) plus a small wording-economy pass (one duplicate Context-References bullet, one duplicate aux_dispatch[]-reaches-Move-3 sentence, one tightened D4-exception lead-in -- no operational content removed) reclaimed 992 B, landing at 20,325 B measured via wc -c -- 325 B still over ceiling. None of this task's editable files are eager-loaded, so this removal could not and did not touch the eager_load figure below; the residual 325 B overage is a separate, pre-existing concern this task did not fully close.

commands/orchestrate.md.derivation: Original ROADMAP.md 'Budgets' target was 8,000 B; unreachable without relocating this file's ~10 KB STAGE 0 executable bash block, which is out of scope (a code-relocation change, not a documentation trim). Growth history: 15,812 B (2026-09-07) -> 19,967 B (2026-09-18, focus-prompt/forced-phase/cycle-budget documentation task) -> 20,228 B (2026-09-18, same-day sibling task's batch-orchestration-default documentation landing two more pointer lines). Reviewed, dated ceiling move: final measured size (20,228 B) + 500 B, rounded up to the next 500 B = 21,000 B. A restatement trim of the Options table's --fast/--research/--plan/--implement rows and the forced-phase Constraints bullet (duplicating docs/architecture/orchestrate-state-machine.md) remains available as a future follow-up once the file is not concurrently claimed by another in-flight task.

eager_load.note: Regression check fails ABOVE baseline_bytes (via 'REPO_ROOT=$(pwd) bash scripts/measure-eager-context.sh --check', parsing the 'TOTAL: <bytes> B' line). baseline_bytes is a fixed recorded ceiling and must never be silently re-derived from a fresh measurement -- only a deliberate, reviewed change should move it. Re-measured during the per-dispatch worktree-isolation removal task (both immediately before and immediately after that task's edits, with an identical result): 67,980 B, 2,030 B over baseline_bytes. This overage PRE-DATES and is UNTOUCHED by that removal -- none of its editable files (verified live against measure-eager-context.sh's own per-file listing) are eager-loaded, so the removal could not move this figure in either direction. baseline_bytes remains unmoved; this is an honest report of an existing, unrelated overage, not a new regression from that task.
